plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• No of Posts : 45 Posts
• JCO (Religious Teacher) : 01 (Uttarakhand)
• Soldier (GD) : 31 (All India)
• Soldier (Clerk SD) : 02 (All India)
• Soldier / Dresser : 01 (All India)
• Soldier / Equipment Repair : 02 (All India)
• Soldier / Tailor : 03 (All India)
• Soldier / Carpenter : 01 (All India)
• Soldier / House Keeper : 02 (All India)
• Soldier / Chef Community : 01 (All India)
• Soldier / Black Smith : 01 (All India)
• Total : 45

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• The selection process differs for Ex-Servicemen and Ex-Women Employees. Candidates will be assessed through the prescribed physical, proficiency, medical and interview stages.
• Medical Examination: Candidates shortlisted after the physical test will undergo a medical examination.
• Interview: Candidates qualifying in the physical and medical examinations will be interviewed by the Board of Officers (BOO).
• Interview by the Board of Officers (BOO).
• Medical examination.
• Complete document verification and the applicable physical or proficiency tests.

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. Domain Technical / Trade Subject | 60 Qs | 60 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Aptitude & Numerical Ability | 15 Qs | 15 Marks | 90–120
• 3. Reasoning & General Awareness | 15 Qs | 15 Marks | Minutes
• 4. General English | 10 Qs | 10 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Technical Exam) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 90–120 Mins
• Exam Mode: Written / Online Objective Test (CBT) + Practical Skill/Trade Test
• Weightage: 60%–70% questions from concerned Engineering Diploma / ITI Trade
• Skill Test: Practical Trade Test is qualifying in nature

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Core Technical / Trade Discipline: Core Trade Theory (Fitter / Welder / Electrician / Machinist / Electronics / Civil / Mech), Workshop Calculation, Engineering Drawing & Safety Rules, Measuring Instruments (Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Gauges), Machines, Thermodynamics / Electrical Circuits / Shipbuilding Basics
• 2. Quantitative Aptitude: Number System, Fractions, Decimals & Percentage, Ratio & Proportion, Average, Profit & Loss, Time & Work, Speed & Distance, Mensuration (Area, Volume of Cylinder, Cone, Sphere), Basic Algebra & Trigonometry
• 3. Reasoning & General Intelligence: Number & Alphabet Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Blood Relations, Direction Sense & Seating Arrangement, Non-Verbal Mirror/Water Images & Figure Completion
• 4. General Awareness & English: Current Affairs, Defense PSUs & Indian Economy, Basic General Science (Physics & Chemistry Laws), Indian Polity & Geography, Basic English Grammar, Articles, Prepositions & Comprehension

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (TECHNICAL PSU) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

• 26 : Trade Apprentice (Electrician)
• Post Codes : Qualification Required
• 01 to 06 (Graduate Apprentice, engineering fields) : B.E. / B.Tech. or equivalent qualification in the respective field with an aggregate minimum of 60% marks as declared by Government recognized University / Board / Institute.
• 07 to 09 (Graduate Apprentice, B.Com, BCA, BA Hindi/English) : Graduation in the respective field with minimum 60% marks as declared by Government recognized University / Board / Institute.
• 10 to 14 (Technician Apprentice) : Diploma in Engineering / Technology in the respective field with first class by recognized State Board of Technical Education.
• 15 to 18 (Trade Apprentice) : SSC/Matriculation/10th and ITI (NTC/STC) in the relevant trade.
• 19 to 26 (Trade Apprentice) : ITI (NTC/STC) from a recognized institute of Gujarat State.
• Post Codes : Age Limit

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• At document verification, the hard copy of the online application summary must be produced with self-attested copies of the following
• Candidates shortlisted for document verification are not eligible for Travelling Allowance.
• The last date is 02-12-2026. The site remains open for online registration until 1700 hours on that day, and applications opened on 11-11-2026 at 0930 hours.

• 1. General Awareness & Science | 40 Qs | 40 Marks | Combined

General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding and Decoding, Mathematical Operations, Relationships, Syllogism & Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Statement-Conclusion & Statement-Assumptions, Analytical Reasoning, Directions & Classification

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• Trades : Technician Apprentice (Mechanical), Technician Apprentice (Electrical), Technician Apprentice (Telecommunication & Instrumentation), Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource), Trade Apprentice (Accountant), Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices), Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders)
• Eastern Region Pipelines: Total : 116
• Western Region Pipelines: Total : 149
• Northern Region Pipelines: Total : 110
• Southern Region Pipelines: Total : 46
• South Eastern Region Pipelines: Total : 79
• Pipelines Division: Total : 500
• Technician Apprentice (Mechanical) : Three years (or lateral entry after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course) full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Automobile Engineering.
• Technician Apprentice (Electrical) : Three years (or lateral entry after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course) full time Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Electrical & Electronics Engineering.
• Technician Apprentice (Telecommunication & Instrumentation) : Three years (or lateral entry after Class-XII (Sc)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma course) full time Diploma in any of the disciplines of Engineering listed below the table, from a Govt. recognized Institute.
• Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource) : Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) from a Govt. recognized Institute/University.
• Trade Apprentice (Accountant) : Full Time Bachelor degree (Graduation) in Commerce from a Govt. recognized Institute/University.
• Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentices) : Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate).
• Domestic Data Entry Operator (Skill Certificate Holders) : Minimum 12th Pass (but below Graduate), and a Skill Certificate of 'Domestic Data Entry Operator' for training of less than one year, issued by an awarding body recognized under National Skill Qualifications Framework or any other authority recognized by the Central Govt.
• Trade : Suitable disabilities
• Technician Apprentice (Mechanical/Electrical/Telecommunication & Instrumentation) : Leprosy cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack victims; multiple disabilities from amongst these
• Trade Apprentice (Accountant) : Hard of Hearing; Musculoskeletal (One Leg, Both Legs), Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims; multiple disabilities from amongst these
• Trade Apprentice (Assistant-Human Resource) : Low Vision; Hard of Hearing; Musculoskeletal (One Arm, One Leg, Both Legs, One Arm & One Leg), Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims; multiple disabilities from amongst these
• Data Entry Operator and Domestic Data Entry Operator : Hard of Hearing; Musculoskeletal (One Leg, Both Legs), Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims; multiple disabilities from amongst these
• SC/ST (against reserved positions) : Up to 5 years
• OBC (NCL) (against reserved positions) : Up to 3 years
• PwBD (irrespective of reservation of posts) : Up to 10 years

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• SRPL Tamil Nadu Asanur, Chengelpet, Chennai, Madurai, Ramanathapuram, Sankari, Trichy 38
• Selection is by a Panel cum Merit List, followed by document verification and medical fitness. There is no written test or personal interview.
• At document verification, bring the originals with a self-attested copy of each, plus a passport size photograph and self-attested copies of certificates/mark sheets
• Latest caste certificate in the Government prescribed proforma, issued by the Competent Authority, for reserved category candidates.

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Awareness & Science | 40 Qs | 40 Marks | Combined
• 2. Mathematics | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 90 Minutes
• 3. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | (1.5 Hours)
• Total (Railway CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 90 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (Multi-Shift Normalized)
• Marking Scheme: +1 Mark per question | Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) Mark per wrong answer
• Shortlisting for DV: 1:1 Ratio of RRB-Wise Notified Vacancies

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Mathematics: Number System, BODMAS, Decimals & Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportions, Percentage, Profit & Loss, SI & CI, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Pipes, Mensuration, Algebra, Geometry & Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics (Mean, Median, Mode, SD)
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding and Decoding, Mathematical Operations, Relationships, Syllogism & Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Statement-Conclusion & Statement-Assumptions, Analytical Reasoning, Directions & Classification
• 3. General Science (NCERT 10th Level): Physics: Motion, Work, Energy, Light, Electricity, Units, Chemistry: Atomic Structure, Periodic Table, Acids/Bases, Metals, Biology: Human Body Systems, Diseases, Nutrition, Plant Kingdom, Environmental Science & Basic Computer Applications
• 4. General Awareness & Current Affairs: Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Railways History, Zones & DFCCIL Facts, Indian Polity, Constitution & Governance, History of India & Freedom Struggle, Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India, UN Organizations, Space (ISRO) & Defense Programs

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (RAILWAY) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

plain_full_description:
=== 1. POST-WISE QUALIFICATION & ELIGIBILITY ===
• RRB GROUP D 2026 Result Out : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: 1st Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-1 Screening)
• Stage 2: 2nd Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-2) / CBAT / Typing Skill Test
• Stage 3: Document Verification (DV) & Railway Medical Fitness Test (A2/B1/C2)

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Awareness & Science | 40 Qs | 40 Marks | Combined
• 2. Mathematics | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 90 Minutes
• 3. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | (1.5 Hours)
• Total (Railway CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 90 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (Multi-Shift Normalized)
• Marking Scheme: +1 Mark per question | Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) Mark per wrong answer
• Shortlisting for DV: 1:1 Ratio of RRB-Wise Notified Vacancies

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Mathematics: Number System, BODMAS, Decimals & Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportions, Percentage, Profit & Loss, SI & CI, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Pipes, Mensuration, Algebra, Geometry & Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics (Mean, Median, Mode, SD)
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding and Decoding, Mathematical Operations, Relationships, Syllogism & Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Statement-Conclusion & Statement-Assumptions, Analytical Reasoning, Directions & Classification
• 3. General Science (NCERT 10th Level): Physics: Motion, Work, Energy, Light, Electricity, Units, Chemistry: Atomic Structure, Periodic Table, Acids/Bases, Metals, Biology: Human Body Systems, Diseases, Nutrition, Plant Kingdom, Environmental Science & Basic Computer Applications
• 4. General Awareness & Current Affairs: Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Railways History, Zones & DFCCIL Facts, Indian Polity, Constitution & Governance, History of India & Freedom Struggle, Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India, UN Organizations, Space (ISRO) & Defense Programs

=== 5. 🏆 POST-RESULT & DOCUMENT VERIFICATION (DV) TO-DO CHECKLIST ===
• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.
• Organize Original 10th/12th/Degree Certificates, Valid OBC/EWS/SC/ST Caste Certificate & Domicile.
• Prepare 8 Passport Photographs, Official ID Proof & Medical Fitness readiness for final joining.

Additionally, candidates must be proficient in the local language of the State/UT (reading, writing, speaking, and understanding) under the concerned recruiting office.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Skill Test)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Tier-1: Computer Based Examination (Objective MCQs — 200 Marks)
• Tier-2: Mains Computer Based Examination (Paper-I Compulsory + Data Entry / Skill Test)
• Stage-3: Document Verification (DV) by User Department & Medical Fitness

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Combined
• 2. General Awareness & GK | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | 60 Minutes
• 3. Quantitative Aptitude | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | (1 Hour)
• 4. English Comprehension | 25 Qs | 50 Marks | Total Time
• Total (Tier-1 CBT) | 100 Qs | 200 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (TCS Pattern Objective MCQs)
• Marking Scheme: +2 Marks for each correct answer | Negative Marking: -0.50 Marks (Tier-1)
• Medium of Exam: Bilingual (English & Hindi)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude (Arith + Adv): Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Simple & Compound Interest, Installments, Ratio, Mixture, Alligation & Average, Time & Work, Time Speed & Distance, Algebra Identities & Surds/Indices, Geometry (Triangles, Circles, Chords), Mensuration 2D & 3D (Prism, Pyramid, Cone), Trigonometry, Height & Distance, DI
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Number & Missing Series, Analogy, Coding-Decoding & Odd One Out, Syllogism & Venn Diagrams, Blood Relations & Direction Test, Dice, Cube & Paper Folding/Cutting, Mirror/Water Image & Embedded Figures, Mathematical Operations (BODMAS), Seating Arrangement & Matrix
• 3. English Comprehension: Grammar Error Spotting & Sentence Improvement, Active-Passive Voice & Direct-Indirect Narration, Cloze Passage & Reading Comprehension, One Word Substitution (OWS), Idioms & Phrases, Synonyms, Antonyms & Spellings, Para Jumbles (PQRS)
• 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

=== 5. ⚡ FINAL 30-DAY ADMIT CARD REVISION & EXAM HALL TO-DO LIST ===
• Days 1–10 (Formula & Concept Revision): Revise all high-weightage formulas, grammar rules & 6-month Current Affairs.
• Days 11–20 (Shift-Timed Mocks): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily at the exact shift time printed on your Admit Card.
• Days 21–30 (Accuracy Lock & Hall Readiness): Review Error Notebook, lock 90%+ accuracy & print Admit Card + ID.

• 2. • 4. General Awareness & Science: Indian Polity (Articles, Amendments, Writs), Ancient, Medieval & Modern History (INC, 1857), Indian & World Geography (Rivers, Passes, Soils), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Vitamins), Indian Economy, Five-Year Plans & Budget, Static GK (Classical/Folk Dances, Festivals, Awards), Last 1 Year Current Affairs, Sports & Books

• RRB Station Master Apply Online 2026, Link Active Till 25 November : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: 1st Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-1 Screening)
• Stage 2: 2nd Stage Computer Based Test (CBT-2) / CBAT / Typing Skill Test
• Stage 3: Document Verification (DV) & Railway Medical Fitness Test (A2/B1/C2)

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. General Awareness & Science | 40 Qs | 40 Marks | Combined
• 2. Mathematics | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 90 Minutes
• 3. General Intelligence & Reasoning | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | (1.5 Hours)
• Total (Railway CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 90 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (Multi-Shift Normalized)
• Marking Scheme: +1 Mark per question | Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) Mark per wrong answer
• Shortlisting for DV: 1:1 Ratio of RRB-Wise Notified Vacancies

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Mathematics: Number System, BODMAS, Decimals & Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportions, Percentage, Profit & Loss, SI & CI, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Pipes, Mensuration, Algebra, Geometry & Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics (Mean, Median, Mode, SD)
• 2. General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding and Decoding, Mathematical Operations, Relationships, Syllogism & Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Statement-Conclusion & Statement-Assumptions, Analytical Reasoning, Directions & Classification
• 3. General Science (NCERT 10th Level): Physics: Motion, Work, Energy, Light, Electricity, Units, Chemistry: Atomic Structure, Periodic Table, Acids/Bases, Metals, Biology: Human Body Systems, Diseases, Nutrition, Plant Kingdom, Environmental Science & Basic Computer Applications
• 4. General Awareness & Current Affairs: Current Events of National & International Importance, Indian Railways History, Zones & DFCCIL Facts, Indian Polity, Constitution & Governance, History of India & Freedom Struggle, Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India, UN Organizations, Space (ISRO) & Defense Programs

• Download Official Merit List / Answer Key PDF and verify your Roll Number & Category Cut-Off.

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Phase 1: Preliminary Online Examination (Objective CBT — Qualifying)
• Phase 2: Mains Online Examination (Objective + Descriptive Test)
• Phase 3: Language Proficiency Test (LPT) / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• 1. English Language | 30 Qs | 30 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 2. Numerical Ability / Quant | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• 3. Reasoning Ability | 35 Qs | 35 Marks | 20 Minutes
• Total (Prelims CBT) | 100 Qs | 100 Marks | 60 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Online Computer Based Test (CBT) with Sectional Timing
• Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks (1/4th) deducted for each wrong answer
• Mains Pattern: GA/Banking Awareness, English, Reasoning & Computer, Data Analysis & DI (200 Marks)

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Quantitative Aptitude & DI: Simplification & Approximation, Missing & Wrong Number Series, Quadratic Equations, Data Interpretation (Table, Pie, Bar, Caselet), Percentage, Profit & Loss, Discount, Ratio, Partnership & Ages, Time & Work, Pipes & Cisterns, Time, Speed, Distance & Boats
• 2. Reasoning Ability & Puzzles: Sitting Arrangement (Linear, Circular, Square), Puzzles (Floor, Flat, Box, Month/Day Based), Syllogism (Only / Only a Few), Inequalities (Coded & Direct), Blood Relations & Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding & Alphanumeric Series, Input-Output & Data Sufficiency, Logical & Critical Reasoning
• 3. English Language: Reading Comprehension (Economy/Finance Tone), Cloze Test & Fillers (Double/Triple), Error Detection & Sentence Improvement, Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement, Word Swap, Connectors & Starters, Vocabulary, Idioms & Phrasal Verbs
• 4. Banking & General Awareness: Last 6 Months Current Affairs (National & Global), RBI Monetary Policy, Repo, CRR, SLR & Basel Norms, NPCI Digital Products (UPI, CBDC, AePS, NACH), Priority Sector Lending (PSL) & NPA Norms, Union Budget, Economic Survey & Govt Schemes, Static Banking, Headquarters & Financial Terms

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (BANKING) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.

• UPSC Urdu Literature Syllabus 2025 : 10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma / Bachelor Degree in relevant discipline from a recognized Board or University (Refer Official Notification PDF). (Various Posts)

=== 2. SELECTION PROCESS ===
• Stage 1: Preliminary Examination (General Studies + CSAT / Aptitude)
• Stage 2: Mains Written Examination (General Studies + Essay / Optional)
• Stage 3: Personality Test / Interview & Document Verification

=== 3. EXAM PATTERN ===
• Paper-I: General Studies (GS) & Current Affairs | 140–150 Qs | 200 Marks | 120 Minutes
• Paper-II: CSAT / General Hindi / Aptitude | 60–100 Qs | 100–200M | 120 Minutes
• Exam Mode: Offline OMR / Online Objective Prelims followed by Mains
• Negative Marking: 1/3rd (0.33) or 0.25 Marks per wrong answer as per Commission norms

=== 4. DETAILED SUBJECT-WISE SYLLABUS ===
• 1. Indian Polity, History & Culture: Indian Constitution, Parliament, Judiciary & Panchayati Raj, Ancient, Medieval & Modern Indian History, Indian National Movement (1857–1947), Art, Culture & State-Specific Heritage
• 2. Geography, Environment & Economy: Physical, Social & Economic Geography of India & World, Ecology, Biodiversity, Climate Change & National Parks, Sustainable Development, Budget, Fiscal & Monetary Policy
• 3. General Science & Current Affairs: Everyday Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Space & Biotech), National & International Current Events (Last 12 Months), Government Welfare Schemes & Census Data
• 4. Aptitude, Reasoning & Language: Comprehension & Interpersonal Communication Skills, Logical Reasoning, Analytical Ability & Decision Making, General Mental Ability & Class 10th Level Numeracy / Language

=== 5. 🎯 90-DAY MASTER PREPARATION TO-DO ROADMAP (STATE PSC CIVIL) ===
• Month 1 (Days 1–30 | Foundation & Syllabus Decoding): Complete topic-wise concepts, build short formula notes & solve 50 questions daily.
• Month 2 (Days 31–60 | Speed, PYQs & Sectional Mastery): Solve last 5 years' Official PYQs with timer & attempt 3 sectional mocks weekly.
• Month 3 (Days 61–90 | Full-Length Mocks & Error Log): Attempt 1 Full Mock daily, revise Error Notebook & lock 90%+ accuracy.
